identity.description: Density-based clusterer: grows clusters from core points (≥ min_samples neighbors within eps), discovering arbitrarily-shaped clusters WITHOUT choosing k, and labeling sparse points as noise (-1). Its defining operational edge: sklearn's DBSCAN has NO predict() for new points — assignment of unseen rows is a wrapper responsibility, which is exactly what makes it a wrapper-needs case study for the family.

consumes.note: the canonical high-dimensional fix: embed first (PCA/UMAP), then density-scan — raw density is meaningless under distance concentration

emits.note: labels_ with -1 = noise; no parametric summary exists — clusters ARE their density-connected member sets, hence paramsAsOutput none (contrast kmeans' centroids). The noise flag doubles as a crude anomaly signal (secondaryTasks)

eps.note: read off the k-distance-plot knee rather than blind-searched; only meaningful AFTER scaling

invariances.why: the eps-ball is a fixed-radius Euclidean neighborhood; an unscaled high-variance feature stretches the ball into a sliver along every other axis, destroying the density estimate
a monotone feature map changes pairwise distances nonlinearly, so core/border/noise status flips under log or rank transforms
neighborhood radius queries are undefined on missing coordinates — imputation is a precondition
density in an encoded categorical space is an artifact of the encoding, not the data; distances between one-hot vectors take only a few discrete values, so eps has no meaningful resolution

density-reachability imposes NO cluster shape — arbitrary, non-convex clusters are its selling point; the one implicit assumption is a single GLOBAL density level (one eps), which is an edge case, not a distributional form
tree-indexed neighbor queries give ~O(n log n) to ~10^5 rows, but high dimensions force brute-force pairwise work and memory blowups well before that
there is no decision function at all off the training set — the fit is a labeling of the training rows, nothing more

featureStats.why: eps is read off the knee of the sorted kth-nearest-neighbor distance curve; a curve with no knee means no density separation exists and DBSCAN will return all-noise or one blob
distance concentration makes 'dense neighborhood' meaningless as p grows — beyond roughly p>20 the eps-ball contains either everything or nothing, gating toward embed-then-scan
a fixed-radius ball only makes sense when features share a scale; large variance spread is a mandatory-scaling flag before eps can be tuned at all

modelMetrics.why: the first honesty check for a density fit — near-1 noise means eps too small (nothing is dense), near-0 with one cluster means eps too large (everything is one blob); the useful regime is in between
silhouette computed on non-noise points measures how separated the recovered dense regions are; there is no holdout AUC for an unlabeled task — this plus stability IS the validation
a cluster count that survives an eps-neighborhood sweep indicates real density structure; a knife-edge count that changes with tiny eps perturbations is parameterization artifact

edgeCases.behavior: a single global eps cannot fit both — the loose cluster dissolves into noise or the tight pair merges

edgeCases.condition: eps too small for the data's density
edgeCases.behavior: everything labeled noise (-1); zero clusters, silently 'successful'
one giant cluster swallowing all structure
distance concentration — the k-distance curve flattens and no eps separates dense from sparse

edgeCases.condition: border point reachable from two clusters
edgeCases.behavior: assignment depends on row order — the one non-deterministic seam in an otherwise deterministic fit
no native predict() exists — naive refit-with-new-rows silently relabels everything

driver.wrapperNeeds: REQUIRED for the score path: sklearn DBSCAN exposes fit_predict only — the wrapper must implement new-point assignment as nearest-core-sample-within-eps (label of the nearest core point if within eps, else noise), which in turn requires persisting core_sample_indices_ + components_ alongside the fitted object
driver.threadSafety: neighbor search honors n_jobs; fitted labeling is read-only thereafter

canBeSeeds.via: cluster-id (noise flag -1 routes rows out before a downstream fit)

placementClaims.why: radius queries are undefined on NaN — no neighborhood, no density
heavy tails create spurious low-density gaps along the tail; symmetrizing transforms make a single global eps more tenable
a fixed-radius Euclidean ball is only meaningful on commensurate axes — unscaled features make eps un-tunable by mechanism
distances must exist before density does; but one-hot geometry quantizes distances so coarsely that heavy-categorical inputs are better routed away from density methods entirely
